# Turn a payroll register into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free payroll register to journal converter: checks every employee row, books wages and employer taxes as expenses and every withholding as a liability, totals the 941 deposit for each pay run, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
